name: comp-57
title: Inline Tags Input
blurb: Tag input with tags displayed inline alongside the input.
description: A tag input built with emblor where tags appear inline in the same container as the input field. Starts with Red tag. Close buttons for each tag.
use_when: Compact tag entry where space is limited and inline display is preferred.
avoid_when: You need tags in a separate list below the input (see comp-56).
a11y: Label linked to input. Inline tags with close buttons. Active tag state managed.
